context: PO explicitly chose independent curation in a new context, with subsequent human review. Development judgments and one audit compatibility call do not complete the reserved v2 gate.
decision: Freeze selected candidate sources and requested profile before new-context independent curation; keep raw reserved cases private. CLI only validates bounded protocol metadata and never grants execution authority. Exact corpus review and candidate bindings become stale on relevant changes.

limitations: Metadata digests and identities are declarations; preparation does not open or validate reserved payloads.

review_note: Reviewed pure contracts, 31 synthetic gate/CLI tests and explicit authority limits. No payload validation or semantic efficacy inferred.
summary: Additive typed protocol and preparation report separate candidate freeze, isolated curation, human expectation review and future authorized execution.
